title: comms.usage.reported.v1
description: One clinic's message usage for one closed clinic-local day (COM-015): counts and provider cost by channel and pricing category, published by the Comms Gateway's daily rollup. Counts and amounts only: no recipient, no message content. The envelope id is 'usage:<tenantId>:<day>', so a repeat is the same event.

category.description: Provider pricing category: Meta's (marketing, utility, authentication, service) or the SMS DLT category.

costMinor.description: The day's provider cost in the currency's minor unit, before any Nabd markup.

whatsappMonthCount.description: WhatsApp messages of the calendar month up to and including this day: what a plan allowance is measured against.

version.description: Epoch day of 'day': monotonic per clinic.
